conventions.units: metres, 1 Unity unit = 1 m; FBX exported with FBX_SCALE_ALL + apply transform: import Scale Factor 1, Convert Units on, no rotation on the meshes
conventions.axes: Unity Y up, model front (nose / bow / forks / gun) = local +Z
conventions.pivot: centre of the footprint on the ground (min y = 0); WATER models: on the waterline (hull below y = 0) -> place at sea level 0.0
conventions.placement: replace the W85 grey box: position = data pos (x, ground or sea level, y); rotation = Quaternion.Euler(0, unity_yaw_deg, 0) where unity_yaw_deg = -rot_deg + yaw_offset_deg (the boxes used Euler(0, -rot_deg, 0)); uniform scale only (1.0 except yachts)
conventions.lod: each FBX holds <Name>_LOD0 and <Name>_LOD1 -> Unity builds the LODGroup on import (LOD1 ~31-48 % tris); suggested transitions 60 % / 15 % / cull 2 %
conventions.static: all static (BatchingStatic) except patrol_boat (moves on its route)
conventions.materials: one URP Lit material per family + colour variant: MW86_<Family>_<A|B|C> = same shader, _BaseMap = MW86_<Family>_<V>.png, _BaseColor white, Smoothness 0.1, Metallic 0; variants only swap the texture (SRP Batcher friendly)
conventions.texture_import: sRGB, Wrap Clamp, Filter Bilinear, mipmaps ON, no compression (or High Quality), max size 512. Flat faces use one UV point per face (cell centre) so mips never bleed; camo / teak / hazard / wagon boards are projected patterns

families.Water: yachts, boats, jet ski, SUP: white / teak / navy (A), navy hull (B), teal stripe (C)
families.Military: Tramduro: olive camo (A, default), desert (B), parade grey-green low-contrast (C)
families.Machines: construction yellow / orange, P3 blue stacker + forklift (A), alternates B / C; wagon rust-red (A, data tint #8C4A36), green (B), brown (C)
